description.mn: Acqua di Parma Sandalo: Unisex модлог үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: нимбэг, бергамот, жүрж, петигрейн; зүрхний ноот: лаванда, кардамон; суурь ноот: зандан мод, хув, тонка шош.
description.en: Sandalo Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Sandalo Eau de Parfum was launched in 2019. Top notes are lemon, calabrian bergamot, orange and petitgrain; middle notes are lavender and cardamom; base notes are sandalwood, amber and tonka bean.
